Platzi, a 45-person company with teams across San Francisco, Bogotá, and Mexico City, struggled to manage travel for its globally distributed workforce. Before NexTravel, booking flights and accommodations was messy, requiring multiple travel sites, aggregators, and spreadsheets to track reservations and refunds.

NexTravel provided Platzi with a centralized platform to book, manage, and report travel arrangements, with customization for different management options and integration of airline loyalty accounts. As a result, Platzi gained easier trip handling, better control over payment methods and business-mile accrual, and improved visibility into travel schedules and savings.
